title: 502 em todas as requisições logo após deploy de uma regra WAF com regex que faz backtracking
what_it_tests: Correlacionar pico de CPU/502 com o deploy certo, em minutos, ignorando um deploy trivial e um ticket antigo parecido mas de outra causa.

ticket.subject: API returning 502 for every request since around 13:45 UTC
ticket.description: Multiple customers report HTTP 502 on all API calls starting around 13:45 UTC. Happens in every region. Service: acme/edge-gateway.

comments.author: Marcus (Platform Team)
comments.body: CPU alerts firing on all gateway nodes. Status page updated to major outage.

related_tickets.subject: Latency spike after enabling new request validation rule
related_tickets.resolution: A new validation regex backtracked heavily on long payloads. Rolled back the rule and added an evaluation time limit.

related_tickets.subject: Customer seeing 502s from their own load balancer
related_tickets.resolution: Customer's load balancer health check pointed at the wrong port. Fixed on their side.

deploys.message: feat(waf): add managed rule to block inline JS injection in query params
deploys.author: Lena

logs.message: waf ruleset version 2026.09.16-1 loaded (1 new rule: id=1003)
worker cpu=100% for 30s, request queue depth 12840
timeout evaluating waf rule id=1003 (rule_eval_ms=4870) on request with 9KB query string
502 Bad Gateway returned to client, upstream worker unavailable

ground_truth.root_cause: The WAF rule id 1003 shipped in commit 7c19e4b contains a regular expression with catastrophic backtracking. It exhausts CPU on every gateway worker, which then returns 502. Roll back the rule and add a regex evaluation time limit.
